planets.name: LHS 1140 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1140 with a 24.7-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: LHS 1140 b was found in 2017 by MEarth Project as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LHS 1140. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CADIEUX_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2017, disc_facility MEarth Project, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 24.7369148, pl_radj 0.15434053, pl_bmassj 0.01761957

quotes.title: LHS 1140 b
quotes.card: LHS 1140 b is an exoplanet orbiting within the conservative habitable zone of the red dwarf star LHS 1140.
quotes.introduction: Discovered in 2017 by the MEarth Project, LHS 1140 b is about 5.6 times the mass of Earth and about 70% larger in radius, putting it within the super-Earth category of planets.
